annotations.title: Read a chapter (free) or its opening (paid)

description: Return the text of one chapter. Free chapters come back in full. A paid chapter comes back whole to an account that owns it (the book, or the chapter bought with buy_chapter) when the call carries its token; to anybody else as its public lead-in only (about a fifth of the chapter), with what the chapter costs on its own. Get book slugs and chapter ids from list_books. Read-only.

locale.description: Language of the result: en, ru, pt or es.
